guides.favoredWhen: Skill lane you can win. Stack three nails, E in, and hold W for Charm.

keyTips.text: Skill lane you can win: three nails, E in to pop them and proc Electrocute, W out.
Q her only when she is on your side: overextended nails never cash.
Pre-cast W a bit early on engage: the dodge slips her Charm.

tips.text: Level 1, do not trade: her W speed procs Electrocute on you.
She spaces your nails and backs off as they stack: walk her down before the third lands.
She Ignites your Soul Ignition healing: expect it, bait it or power through.
After 6 play with your jungler: you own the early, convert with help.
R-for-R is fine: yours returns sooner ({cd:805:R}), so trade ults and re-engage in the window.

guides.favoredWhen: Stomp. Spam Q, blink the stun, and all-in at every stage.

keyTips.text: Stomp matchup: spam Q and blink her stun, then run the combo.
Simple E, QQQ, E2: the full rotation every time.
Her stun cooldown is far longer than your E: punish after every E.

tips.text: Spam Q from level 1: nails stack while she cannot answer.
Your E goes over her stun: engage through it, never around.
All-in at every stage: no level is hers.
She wants the long outscale lane: keep waves crashing so it never settles.
Stun blinked plus every stage all-inned: the Syndra who never holds you never wins.

guides.favoredWhen: Even. Respect the triple-Q burst, answer jumps with double-W backwards, and Ignite before his W recast.

keyTips.text: Even matchup: respect his triple-Q burst, nothing more.
When he jumps on you, double-W Q-E backwards: retreat while landing everything.
Ignite before his W recast: less healing means the trade sticks.

early-lane.text: Zed often places Living Shadow before Death Mark so he can swap away from skillshots. Hold your crowd control until he has used the swap.

win-condition.text: Death Mark always lands Zed behind his target. Pre-aim crowd control and escapes behind you, not toward where he cast it.

tips.text: Open with Q stacks: the burst threat starts the lane.
Do not E into his shadows blindly: spent mobility is death.
His W is the engage tool: backwards combo every time he commits it.
Ignite timing decides trades: cast before the recast, never after.
Death Mark lands him behind you: pre-aim E behind yourself when he ults.
Burst respected plus backwards combos: the Zed who never dives you never wins.

keyTips.text: Hold the wave near your side early instead of shoving, buying chase room and earlier gank vision.
At level 6, spend the added R damage on kill pressure instead of staying passive.
Reach backlines through fog and W without crossing the map alone into unknown enemies.

tips.text: Play safely into levels and the first major spike; falling behind delays all-in threats.
Test matchups for extended fighting; without it, farm into the next power spike.
Against hard-to-kill lanes, roam strongly after level 6 to build pressure with allies.
Contest harder once the first component lands and Q points stack trade damage.
Pick lone movers with R, then spend the numbers on an objective.
After bot first tower, leave the old lane for side pressure.
With several items done, group and spend R area damage around tight terrain.
Wait out important enemy control before engaging, since hard lockdown ends Locke fast.
Start snowballs on isolated, overextended squishies and turn picks into Baron or map objectives.
Never cross alone without enemy positions; one catch can donate Baron or end the game.
Against grouped enemies, land R on several targets; his area damage favors grouped fights with a safe entry.

itemization.text: Run Flash and Ignite with Electrocute, Sudden Impact, Sixth Sense, and Ultimate Hunter plus Bone Plating and Revitalize on adaptive-force and health shards.
Order Lich Bane, Sorcerer's Shoes, Shadowflame, Zhonya's Hourglass, Rabadon's Deathcap, and Void Staff while maxing Q, then E, then W.
Slot Banshee's Veil fourth defensively into burst or one key control spell.
Keep the Stormraider's Surge alternative and the Conqueror off-meta setup as separate rune and build paths.
